Synopsis:
Player returns to den after letting Wyll return beforehand. NOTE: A NARRATOR NODE IS REQUIRED IN THE FIRST NODE BECAUSE IT IS A SPEAKER SELECTION WITH A CINEMATIC.

Cluster Contexts:
- DEN_AttackOnDen_EntranceMeetingWyll.json: The player has just returned to the den after letting Wyll leave earlier; Wyll has come back and angrily confronts the player in a tense cinematic moment. A narrator node is required first (the scene opens with a cinematic — “the parasite seizes as you approach”) and armed men have turned toward the player with hands on their swords. This takes place in the aftermath of the attack on the Druid Grove: healers and survivors are nearby, Halsin has returned, and the community is still tending wounds and cleaning up. Off‑screen flags from prior encounters (who was spared, which goblin leaders remain, and lingering tensions among grove leaders) may influence how the conversation proceeds.
- Wyll_InParty2.json: Default dialogue when speaking to Wyll during exploration.
- Wyll_Recruitment_PostDruidAttack_PostEA.json: Post EADialogue with Wyll after Druid Attack. In most cases, this will involve him training a tiefling child before the player breaks in, and you discover you were both on the mind flayer ship. Wyll comes across as a big-time hero, and wants help killing goblins. He is called the Blade of Frontiers by most.

context: This scene must open with a narrator cinematic node ("the parasite seizes as you approach") because it is a speaker-selection cinematic; as you enter the den armed men turn toward you with hands on their swords. Wyll — whom you let leave earlier and who has now returned — angrily confronts you, accusing you and threatening to have you killed. The encounter occurs in the immediate aftermath of the attack on the Druid Grove: survivors and healers are nearby, Halsin has returned, and the community is still tending wounds and cleaning up. Off‑screen flags from prior choices (who was spared, which goblin leaders remain, and tensions among grove leaders), plus Wyll’s self‑styled heroism and desire to hunt goblins, will shape how the exchange can proceed.
